label: Szlyk 2004
country: USA (sites: Chicago VA, Hines VA, Deicke Eye Center, Massachusetts Eye and Ear Infirmary, Boston)
setting: four vision rehabilitation programs: three VA/inpatient-type programs and private-sector low vision services (veterans and non-veterans)
recruitment: participants recruited from four rehabilitation programs: VICTORS Chicago VA (20), Hines Blind Rehabilitation Center (49), Deicke Eye Center (32), Massachusetts Eye and Ear Infirmary (16); sampling method NR
notes: Development/Rasch scale study; no sensitivity/specificity or accuracy against a vision measure; no VA or visual field data reported. pct_female = 20/117 computed from 97 men and 20 women (p3). Mean age 72 given only as an integer-valued mean (p3). Interviewer-administered by telephone before admission to rehab (p5). Country not stated explicitly; inferred from site names. Rasch analysis with WINSTEPS 3.16 (p5).
